summary: A proprietary housing with a metal and ABS finish.
headline: Independent chambers. Triple-mic ENC over USB.
description: 50 mm drivers sit in dedicated acoustic chambers. A proprietary design pairs a metallic earcup finish with an ABS frame.

features.text: A boom microphone captures your voice while two auxiliary microphones sample surrounding noise.
